title: Etale unit H2 embeds into Galois unit H2
statement: For every field K, there is an embedding (Spec (.of K)).CohomologicalBrauerGroup ↪ Field.GaloisUnitsH2 K. This asserts injectivity in one direction only.

proof.text: Choose Omega as AlgebraicClosure K, containing the canonical SeparableClosure K. Obtain the abelian geometric stalk equivalence E, its natural comparison i, and its canonical action-on-germs formula. Identify evaluation at the terminal etale object naturally with invariants under E. Identify E(gmSheaf) equivariantly and linearly with separable-closure units.

Use the existing Ext-to-derived-terminal-evaluation additive equivalence in degree 1+1. Apply the general derived-invariants/homogeneous-continuous-cohomology comparison at degree two with the equivariant units coefficient equivalence. Compose the two type equivalences and take their underlying embedding.
